title: System Architecture
definition: A high-level perspective on the organization and interaction of components within a system.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine a house as a system. The architecture is how different rooms and utilities are laid out and connected, allowing the house to function efficiently.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: System architecture refers to the blueprint of a system, outlining its structure, components, and relationships between them. This includes decisions about hardware, software, and data flow.
difficulty_levels.expert: The architecture of a system refers to the fundamental structure and organization of its components, including the software, hardware, and data. It determines the system's ability to scale, adapt, and meet the needs of its users. The architecture also has philosophical implications for the system's principles, goals, and the way it interacts with its environment and users.

extra_fields.insight: The conversation revealed the need to integrate a GPU into the system for heavy lifting tasks, and the flexibility to either connect Paperspace to the Digital Ocean droplet or use a separate GPU-enabled droplet.
